content: PWA habit reminders when app is closed require server-side Web Push, not client timers. Service workers suspend when backgrounded; setTimeout/Periodic Background Sync are unreliable (no Safari/iOS). Push delivery is best-effort with OS-level timing windows. Server cron must evaluate each subscription's IANA timezone and local reminder time; store UTC timestamps but schedule in local time. iOS 16.4+ push requires installed home-screen PWA and immediate showNotification in SW (no silent push).
